execution_backend: Vibe TaskGroup owns isolated native CPU worker processes; no shared-memory threads

release_check.compiler_gate: full successful run on the reviewed fix; seed to stage3 fixed point

validation.native_cli_tests: seven source families at 1/2/4 workers including unpooled long identifiers; invalid settings/source/ABI, trace aliases and a real failing native worker preserve previous output
validation.replay_oracle: stable owner index matches legacy scans; original scan retained
validation.existing_lowering_suite: passed: public CLI parity1/2/4, bounded waves, input freshness, trace aliases and protected output
validation.review_regression: A 318-byte legal identifier compiles ordinarily but makes the old worker image fail with string not in table. Nonthrowing indexed lookup returns a negative miss; shadow range replay and public CLI 1/2/4 builds now preserve exact bytes and execution. Regression is first in the maintained native suite.

protocol.order: a0,b0,s0,p1,p2,p4 then reverse, then forward; each cold followed by warm in its own fresh guest-cache directory

variants.s0: same candidate compiler driver, serial body generation

protocol.allocation_policy: ordinary/parent/worker core engines bump; async coordinator RC; target RC1
protocol.caches: native JIT primed; parsed-source cache cold/warm pairs; checked-module, body and final-artifact caches off
protocol.rss: sum of simultaneously resident process-tree RSS sampled every 10ms; includes frontend, parent, coordinator, workers; shared mappings may be counted in several processes
protocol.timing: external full process lifetime, including native frontend hash/validation/publication; ordinary adapters omit the shell dispatcher; serial driver is a separate control
protocol.paths: compiler a0/b0 and all variant/cache/output directory names have equal lengths
protocol.execution: strict serial runs, no concurrent builds/tests/profiles

machine.filesystem: WSL Linux ext4 worktree under /home, not /mnt/c

interpretation: Keep the CPU route experimental and opt-in; choose promotion from complete walltime and aggregate RSS rather than worker-phase timing.

Ordinary adapter measurements omit the shell dispatcher; parallel measurements include the native Node frontend, image verification, worker lifecycle and publication. Same-driver serial is reported separately.
Both ordinary compilers have matching name-section policy. Baseline normalization removes only its name section and matches the previously verified release artifact.

Separate one-worker discovery runs observed CLI finalize at 6321.82664ms before the owner-row index and 826.485794ms after it. This N1 phase observation is excluded from controlled whole-build measurements and is not an ordinary-build speedup claim.

Ordinary candidate versus ordinary baseline wall medians: compiler cold +0.04%, compiler warm +0.28%, cli cold +1.09%, cli warm +0.78%. Small wall deltas should be treated as noise, not speedup claims.
Four workers change warm walltime versus ordinary by +18.1% compiler / +17.7% CLI, and aggregate RSS by +81.1% / +38.8%. Keep disabled by default.
